name: tutorial
setup: A first hour with Charter for one new player. You name a banner at an anvil, craft it with a lodestone into a Nexus, and place it at the emerald pillar: that founds your faction and raises its keep. Brinewatch, a small rival, holds a keep 12 chunks east and an outpost beyond it. You plant an outpost of your own at the gold pillar, declare war on theirs, and take it.

books.title: Charter: A First Hour
books.author: Charter
pages:
Welcome to Charter

Here factions hold land with keeps that nobody can take, and fight over outposts.

This book takes you through your first hour. Time runs 24 times fast for it.

1. Name a banner

You carry a white banner. An anvil stands beside the emerald pillar. Rename the banner there: its name will be your faction's name.

2. Craft the Nexus

Put the lodestone and your named banner in a crafting table, and nothing else. You get a Nexus with your faction's name on it.

3. Found your faction

Walk to the emerald pillar. Place the Nexus on the ground near it. 64 of your diamonds pay for the keep.

The square of chunks around it is now your keep, and you are its Lord.

Your Charter

The Charter book in your inventory shows where you stand: your Rights, your Freedoms, your faction and its Chronicle.

Use it any time.

4. Fill the treasury

Open your Charter, then your faction. Press Pay in diamond.

A war banner needs 8 diamonds.

5. Stock the granary

Place a chest in the Nexus's chunk: it is your granary. Put 40 bread in.

A keep eats its granary slowly: 14 days from full. When it runs dry the claim lapses.

6. Claim land

Type /charter map. The yellow + squares touch your land: click one to claim it.

On your land, other factions may walk but not build, break or open anything.

7. Meet a rival

Brinewatch holds a keep 12 chunks east, and an outpost beyond it. Walk there. Try to break a block on their land: you cannot.

8. Plant an outpost

At the gold pillar, place the War Banner on the ground. It holds 8 diamonds of yours as a deposit.

It raises for 5 minutes. Till then, anyone may pull it down.

9. Stock the outpost

Place the barrel next to the banner: it is the outpost store. Put 48 bread in.

/outpost takes you to it, at 1 food.

10. Declare war

Once your outpost stands, open your Charter, then War. Name Brinewatch's outpost and confirm.

Nothing can be done to it for 12 hours.

11. Take it

When the notice is over, stand in their outpost's chunk for 10 minutes with none of them there.

The banner falls and its deposit is yours.

What next

A lost outpost costs its owner the deposit, so guard yours: stand in its chunk, or use /outpost to be there.

The full guide is charter/TUTORIAL.md.
